INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_id, workflow_name, execution_id, execution_url, failed_node, error_message, error_stack, payload)
SELECT r.workflow_id, r.workflow_name, r.execution_id, r.execution_url, r.failed_node, r.error_message, r.error_stack, r.payload
FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::workflow_errors, $1::jsonb) AS r
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## Global Error Handler (DLQ)
Recebe qualquer falha não tratada dos workflows que o referenciam em *Settings → Error Workflow*. Persiste em `workflow_errors` e alerta `#automation-ops`. Se o Postgres estiver fora, o alerta informa que a DLQ falhou.
